text:
alex: Quick sync — I sketched a minimal ingest contract for per-route SLO dashboards (p50/p95/p99, TTFT, tokens/sec). Need runtime + infra + console sign-off. https://redwood.internal/rfcs/metrics-ingest
neha: Thanks. Probably the biggest risk is cardinality. Are we planning model+route+env tags? We should avoid user-level tags
samir: +1 on keeping low-cardinality. model_id, route_id, region, model_version, deployment_tier are fair. No user_id or request_id
jess: UX questions: for TTFT do we show ms or s? Also which rollup window? 1m, 5m, 1h?
alex: TTFT in ms in the UI. Backend should emit 1m rollups and we compute 5m/1h in query layer. For percentiles we can either emit HDR histo or summaries; prefer histo at runtime so we can repro roundings
neha: Schema proposal (simple JSON per-minute):
```
metric: "route.latency_ms.hdr",
interval_start: 1670000000,
hdr_base64: "...",
labels: {"model":"m-bert","route":"chat","region":"us-west-2","ver":"v2"}
```
samir: That looks fine. For tokens/sec we can emit counters delta-per-minute as: route.tokens_delta and request_count, then tokens/sec = delta/requests or delta/60
jess: Console panels: show p50/p95/p99 + TTFT + tokens/sec sparkline. Top-10 slowest routes, and a group-by model_version dropdown. Also need an explore view for ad-hoc queries
alex: Telemetry/cost: we can't emit per-request histograms — high cost. Runtime should aggregate per-1m per-model+route pair. Also allow 1% sampling of raw traces for tail analysis
neha: We need naming conventions. Use dot-separated metric names and keep labels for dimensions. Eg: route.latency_ms.hdr + route.latency_ms.p95 as precomputed? I prefer sending hdr so we avoid precomputed inconsistencies
samir: Alerting defaults: p95 < 300ms, p99 < 900ms, TTFT p95 < 100ms for hosted tier. Will be configurable per-customer or per-route. Also add SLA tags for dedicated customers
jess: Minor: show units and latency SLO bands in the panel. Also an annotation for rollouts (when we change model_version) so folks can correlate regressions
deploy-bot: metrics-pipeline: v2 deployed to staging — ingestion endpoint now supports hdr_base64 and per-minute aggregates
neha: One more contract detail: enforce max 8 label keys and whitelist region/model values in ingestion to prevent cardinality explosion. Also a max tag-value length
samir: Runtime will implement label key cap and will map unknown regions to "other". We can also add sampling for low-volume routes
jess: I'll mock a compact panel and flows in Figma and post a link by EOD. Also will add a small dropdown in rollouts UX to toggle "show route SLOs"
alex: Can runtime commit to emitting route.ttft_ms and route.tokens_delta/request_count aggregates by end of next sprint?
samir: Yes, we can deliver the per-minute emitters and a compatibility flag for old metrics. Backfill story: we can reprocess logs for 7 days only
jess: :thumbsup: Scheduling a 30-min sync Tue 10am to finalize schema and console mock. I'll add this thread to the dashboard RFC notes
alex: Thanks all — will update RFC with the sample schema and telemetry cost estimate
_meta: Generated Slack thread for per-route SLO dashboard coordination: routing policies, quotas, telemetry, rollouts UX, and ingest schema discussion.
